metadataRaw.title: How to Strengthen Your Legs and Walk With Less Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows exercises to strengthen your legs to make it easier to walk with less pain.

Each exercise will focus on a different area and muscles (including the hips, knees, and ankles). To get the best results, go through them all and use what works best for you.

Watch now and get stronger legs!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:35 Hip Strengthening
3:29 Knee Strengthening
5:44 Ankle Strengthening
7:44 The King of Leg Exercises
